description:
Imports images from public URLs into Pinsvit and returns one media key per URL, in input order.
Call it before create_post, create_event or create_comment when the user supplies image URLs, then pass the keys as medias.
All-or-nothing: at most 7 URLs per call; a URL that cannot be fetched fails the whole batch. Unattached keys expire after 24 hours.
Velocity limit: 14 URLs per 10 minutes and 50 per day, counting failed URLs too.

urls.description: Public image URLs to import: at most 7 URLs, each at most 2048 characters.

name: get_publishing_media_keys

mediaKeys.description: Media keys, in input order; pass them as medias to create_post, create_event or create_comment.

title: Import images from URLs
